note: Not FMI data. A hand-written example in FMI's format so the demo can show what a warning card looks like when FMI has issued one for the new address. The app shows it only with ?fmi=example and labels the card as an example.

fi.headline: Esimerkki: yöpakkasia Varsinais-Suomessa 30.10.–2.11.
fi.description: Esimerkki demoa varten, ei Ilmatieteen laitoksen varoitus. Tällainen kortti näkyy, kun uudelle paikkakunnalle on muuttoviikolle voimassa oleva varoitus: tyhjäksi jäävän asunnon vesipisteet ja lämmitys kannattaa tarkistaa.

en.headline: Example: night frost in Southwest Finland, 30 Oct to 2 Nov
en.description: An example for the demo, not a warning from the Finnish Meteorological Institute. A card like this appears when the new place has a warning during the move week: check the water points and heating of the home that is left empty.
